title: Filolial Breeding Debate
paragraphs: “Looks like they’ve just arrived. You should ask them for details.”
The Filolial breeder approached Father and the others.
“Whoa… there’s a lot more of them now…”
“What do you think? I believe we’ve met most of the expectations.”
“Needless to say, they seem to have more than enough combat ability.”
“Now, all that’s left is for them to class up. Once the preparations are complete, we plan to deploy them in preparation for the Wave.”
“How about the breeding process?”
“That… depends on asking them personally…”
Father said this to the breeder. For some reason, the breeder frowned.
“It’s hard to give orders to someone you can actually communicate with…”
“Especially when it’s hard to tell them to breed with someone whose appearance is… well…”
“I’d refuse if it were me.”
Itsuki and Ren seemed to agree.
“Hopefully, they’ll be willing if we ask nicely.”
“Bringing a breeding simulation game into reality brings up some strange issues, doesn’t it?”
“Maybe we’ll just have to get used to it?”
“I’d rather not. Especially in Naofumi’s case, since dealing with Sakura and Gaelion makes things more complicated.”
“Ahaha… yeah. Ren and Itsuki are still minors, but watching young girls and boys get involved in that is… well…”
“Even high schoolers do that, you know? But seeing young girls and boys in such situations is a bit much.”
Hmm? Are they talking about marriage and offspring?
I would love to hear more about this!
“Well, in any case, their bodies aren’t ready after just a week or so after birth. I’ll handle that part, so it’s still a bit further down the line.”
“Can I leave that to you?”
“When the time comes, make sure to order them to stay in their Filolial forms.”
“Yeah, I definitely don’t want them doing that in their angel forms.”
“Let’s leave the indecent talk here. For now, I think it’s best to wrap up the leveling on Cal Mira Island and focus on training to prepare for the next Wave activation in Fourbray.”
“…That’s true.”
“Well, since we have so many of them now, I’d love to enter the faster ones in a Filolial race.”
It seems the breeder has a passion for racing. There was a strong determination in his eyes as he watched the Filolials from afar. The Filolials also love running, so they’d be happy to participate.
Oh? Yuki-chan perked up at the mention of a Filolial race and was watching with great interest.
“Yuki-chan, are you interested in the Filolial race?”
“Yes! I, Yuki, want to be the fastest of all!”
Oh! But that’s a declaration that she intends to surpass even Filo-tan!
Are you ready for this, Yuki-chan? That means challenging Filo-tan herself.
Give it your best! Well, whether she can keep up with Filo-tan’s full speed will be something to see.
“Father! Yuki-chan seems interested in the Filolial race!”
“Yuki-chan is one of the higher-level Filolials, so maybe I’ll ask her to give it a try.”
“I’ll do it!”
“Well then, it’s not exactly training, but I’ll leave Yuki-chan in your care.”
“Got it… though, judging by her gait and muscle structure, there are things even experts can’t figure out. Let’s head back to the ranch and observe her for a bit.”
“Alright, everyone! It’s time to leave the island and return to the kingdom!”
“Yes!”

The Filolials all transformed into their Filolial forms and began swimming toward the sea. Of course, they were heading toward the ship Father had prepared for them. The ones who couldn’t fit followed behind.
“Well, shall we leave Cal Mira Island and move on to our next task… searching for that Filolial named Filo?”
“What a ridiculous sight…”
“After watching so many Filolials, Éclair and Gaelion look almost refreshing now.”
Éclair and the others, already on the ship and waving at us, were being watched by Itsuki and Ren, who had rather complicated expressions.
“Heroes, what’s the matter?”
“The island smells like Filolials now… we should leave quickly.”
“Yeah. I mean, poor Imiya-chan got attacked eight times.”
“Indeed. Filolials are wild.”
“Um…”
Éclair and the others murmured as they looked our way.
“Alright, let’s head out.”

Nodding at Father’s words, we set off toward the harbor. When we returned to Melromarc, we had the Filolials class up and then decided to send them to various countries. They weren’t exactly royal guards, but they were welcomed by each nation as a trump card against the Waves. Of course, since Filolials possess high capabilities, everyone seemed to rely on them. It seems that Yuki-chan and Kou will be trained as leaders. While preparing for the Waves, we continued our search for Filo-tan.
“Shield Hero, who’s this person you want me to meet?”
“Ah, well, I was hoping to get some cooperation or at least some opinions. It’s about Filolial research.”
“Who is this guy?”
“Um, this is Ratotil. She’s an alchemist researching monsters in Fourbray and knows a lot about them. So, I figured she’d also know a lot about Filolials.”

It seems Father was trying to connect the breeder and the expert to further Filolial research. Right now, we’re at the breeder’s ranch, letting the Filolials roam freely. Thanks to the increase in their numbers, it’s become quite lively.
“So, you want my help? Well, I’ll take a look at the materials as part of my research.”
“Are you really that knowledgeable about Filolials?”
The breeder has a bit of a rough demeanor. He seemed somewhat skeptical toward the doctor.
“Well, to some extent. Based on the genetic analysis of the Filolial I looked at a while ago, there’s something present in the blood—”
From that point on, it was just a string of technical jargon. I couldn’t understand a thing.
Should I study this too?
“If you understand that much, then this will be quick. I’d like the heroes to raise and observe a certain combination… the renowned feathered Alcorian and—”
However, it seemed that the Filolial breeder understood what the doctor was saying.

“Alcorian is a Philoberil species, right? I’ve seen the breeding chart, but that combination could make the legs unstable. Even with the hero’s correction, any more combinations might actually slow them down… No, wait. Upon examining the Filolial genes, the activation of the YU-type factor suggests that the Philoaria species—”
From that point on, the conversation became quite heated. A string of incomprehensible exchanges followed.

“Motoyasu-kun, could you handle procuring that girl, Luna? If she’s not there, it can’t be helped, but I’ve already spoken to the Queen of Melromarc, so you should be able to get her just by going to the castle.”
“Understood!”
“Then, the rest of us should work on enhancing the classed-up ones…”
“Yes. Preparing for the next Wave… I believe there’s supposed to be one in a neighboring country soon, so we should get ready for that.”

By the way, the monster merchant had set up a tent in a back alley of Melromarc. Apparently, he returned after the queen came back. Thanks to Father’s arrangement, we had already secured the eggs, which were handed over. A gesture of goodwill from the queen. Fortunately, Luna-chan’s egg was still available. Father said he plans to raise her during the next activation event, so it’s being kept safe for now.
Luna-chan… Speaking of which, I wonder where Keel, her beloved, is. Well, we might meet him somewhere eventually.
“Everyone! Fight for the sake of the world!”
“Yes!”
The Filolials responded energetically to my call. Sleeping surrounded by Filolials every night… Life is fulfilling.
“Motoyasu is starting to smell more like Filolials by the day.”
“Even his gear is gradually being replaced with things made from Filolial feathers. His cloak is already a feathered mantle.”
“I wonder how far Motoyasu will go…”
Ren murmured in a tired voice. I will go as far as I need to.
“Well, it’s fine, isn’t it? Oh, by the way, the breeder confirmed that Yuki-chan will be entering the Filolial race.”
“A Filolial race, you say!?”
I leaned toward Father as I asked. I imagined Yuki-chan shining on the track during the Filolial race. …It’s the most magnificent sight.
Chapter 712 – Connections
“Yeah. Normally, there are a lot of complicated procedures, but it seems like they managed to push through and get her into the preliminaries of a graded race.”
“You can actually do that?”
“Seems like they’ve got a lot of connections. Apparently, it’s unheard of for an unknown Filolial to participate.”
“I don’t know much about horse racing, but what’s it like?”

“Think of it this way—unless you place high in the debut race called the New Feather Battle, you don’t even qualify to stand at the starting line. And usually, you have to place in several races before you even get that chance.”
“S-So, it’s quite a prestigious competition then.”
What!? Is that ranch really that powerful? I had noticed it was quite a large ranch, but I hadn’t realized they had so much love for Filolials… I underestimated them.
“Alright, I’ll go bring Yuki-chan.”
“Please do.”

I went to fetch Yuki-chan, who had been training the Filolials raised on Cal Mira Island in combat coordination, and explained the details of the race. Since we had already talked with the breeder about entering Yuki-chan in the race, I was able to convey the information smoothly.
“I’m… suddenly nominated for the preliminaries of such a prestigious race…”
Yuki-chan was trembling with anticipation. She must be excited.
“Motoyasu-sama! This Yuki will meet your expectations no matter what happens!”
“Do your best! Yuki-chan’s radiant form as she runs with all her might is what truly shines.”
“Yes! Then, I’ll go hear the details from Naofumi-sama.”
“Let’s go!”
“I’ll do my best!”
With growing excitement, Yuki-chan and I headed toward Father. When we arrived, I noticed that his assistants, rivals, and the mole were also there.
What’s going on? Of course, Ren and Itsuki were there too.
“Ah, Yuki-chan, you’re here.”
“For the Filolial race, this Yuki will take on the challenge with everything I have!”

“You’re motivated. Alright, here’s the details—the race will be held in Zeltoble. According to the breeder, it’s in two weeks. We need to leave now or we’ll get caught up in the registration process and won’t make it in time.”
“We can use the portal to travel, so we can register immediately.”
“Exactly. We have some leeway with the schedule, but with the Wave approaching, we’ll handle that first. But I think Yuki-chan should go to Zeltoble and see what the race is like.”
“Thank you for your consideration!”
Father then shifted his gaze toward the mole.
“And… I had the Queen of Melromarc investigate various demi-humans, but she couldn’t find any relatives of Imia-chan. With no trace of them here, it’s possible they were taken to Zeltoble.”
“Ah… okay.”
The mole grabbed the hem of Father’s clothes and nodded. Hmm, it seems we have more than just the race—there’s also a search for the mole’s relatives.
With so many goals, this is exciting!
“I hope we can find them…”
“Yeah. Since it works out well, I was thinking we could all head to Zeltoble together. What do you think?”
“No objections here. Isn’t there a shop that deals with meteorite iron series there? I think we should go for Naofumi-san’s skills as well.”
“Yeah, there’s no downside to going.”
“Zeltoble, huh?”
“Is it some kind of unusual country?”
The rival and the assistant tilted their heads. That place is packed with merchants, mercenaries, and crowds.
“I heard it’s a country of mercenaries and merchants. There’s even a coliseum, so I guess there’s plenty of entertainment.”
“Really?”
“Are there any unusual monsters?”

“Hard to say. But since there’s a coliseum, maybe they have monster tournaments too. Besides, we’ve been busy every day on Cal Mira Island, so wouldn’t it be nice to take a break and go somewhere entertaining next?”
“We were swamped with raising Filolials.”
“Yeah, and while the monsters weren’t that strong, we couldn’t afford to let our guard down.”
Ren and Itsuki seemed to agree with Father’s words.
Hmm? Are they complaining about those heavenly days?
“If you’re tired from all that raising, do you two want to stay behind?”
At Father’s question, Ren and Itsuki shook their heads. Both of them seemed motivated.
“Just kidding. I’m interested in the coliseum.”
“Who would turn down a chance to go somewhere that sounds fun?”
“Alright, then. Let’s get ready to depart.”
Following Father’s instructions, the assistant and the mole began packing.
Where’s Éclair? As I was thinking that, I realized she was already preparing nearby.
“Alright, let’s meet up with the breeder and head out.”
“Understood!”
Fully prepared, we used the portal and set off for Zeltoble. ---
“So this is Zeltoble, huh?”
Father murmured as he looked around the plain where the airship had apparently been docked, adjacent to Zeltoble. The airship wasn’t here at the moment.
“Man, heroes really are something else. It’s like I’m dreaming.”
The breeder had tagged along with us through the portal. Well, the portal is a privilege exclusive to us heroes.
“Anyway, I’ll set you up with the inn I favor, so stay there. Or do you heroes usually sleep at the castle in Faubrey?”
“That’s not necessarily the case. Well, with the Wave coming up soon, I am getting a little tired of castle food. Staying in Zeltoble sounds like a nice change.”
“If it’s a lively country with bustling commerce, there’s bound to be good food. We can have Naofumi taste it and improve on it.”
“Sounds delicious!”
“Nano!”
Sakura-chan and the rival spoke in unison to Ren’s words. That’s right. I always look forward to Father’s cooking.
“I’ve got plenty to say about how it’s just assumed that I’ll cook, but oh well…”
With that, we all entered Zeltoble’s capital and were guided to the building arranged by the breeder.
“Alright, I’ll go talk to the race officials. If anything happens, call me.”
“I’ll leave it to you. We’ve got things to do here in Zeltoble too, so we’ll meet up later.”
“Got it.”
And with that, the breeder hurried off. He’s such a hardworking and reliable breeder.
“We’ve secured a place to stay.”

“Yeah. Well, as one of the Four Holy Heroes, we could probably just walk into the guild in Zeltoble… Wait, Zeltoble is a republic, right? If we go to the embassy or something, we could probably get in without any trouble.”
“I can smell the scent of the Filolials here.”

As expected of the breeder’s arrangements. It seems there’s a Filolial barn here. Looking around, I can see that the inn has a wide monster stable. Though, it seems other monsters besides Filolials are staying here too.
“…Motoyasu-kun, this place seems perfect for you.”
“If we go to some formal place like that, we’d end up getting dragged into night parties and tedious meetings, so a casual place like this is just fine.”
“True. We keep getting called over all the time in Faubrey as well.”
“Itsuki always gets asked to perform at those.”
“Yeah…”

Indeed, those noble lifestyles always come with invitations to parties at night. It seems that Ren, Itsuki, and Father are all tired of that. Perhaps they were able to relax more on Cal Mira Island since they didn’t have to deal with any of that there.
“We’re allowed a certain degree of free action, and we’ve informed Faubrey that we’re going to Zeltoble, right?”
“Of course. As always, the heroes have a certain amount of freedom in our movements.”
“Yeah. As long as we’re taking on the Waves, everything else is just extra.”
“Lately, thanks to Rat’s inventions, even reincarnators and summoned individuals have settled down a bit, so we have more freedom to move around. But we didn’t come to Zeltoble just to have fun.”
“Yuki-chan, Kou, let’s go watch the Filolial race!”
“Understood!”
“Yay!”
We immediately set off to watch the Filolial race. Just thinking about it fills me with excitement.
“Motoyasu-kuuun! We want to look for weapons made of meteoric iron!”
“Ren and Itsuki, I know of a shop from a game that deals with weapons like that!”
“Could it be that place? Anyway, understood!”
After getting Itsuki’s approval, Yuki-chan and I swiftly headed to the Filolial race venue.
